prompt: Write the generic container TypedStore<K, V>, then complete StoreUtils: keyOfMax and sumValues need their type parameters bounded (Comparable and Number) before their bodies will even compile, and copyAll shows why a wildcard is needed.
explanation: An unbounded type parameter only gives you Object's methods, so comparing or summing values is impossible until you add a bound: <V extends Comparable<V>> unlocks compareTo and <V extends Number> unlocks doubleValue. The wildcard in copyAll(TypedStore<K, ? extends V> source, TypedStore<K, V> dest) is what lets a store of Integer feed a store of Number -- without it the two type arguments would have to match exactly. Inside TypedStore a LinkedHashMap preserves insertion order while still replacing values in place.
hints: getOrDefault must distinguish a missing key from a key stored with a null value -- containsKey tells them apart.
Change the type parameter lists in StoreUtils: <K, V extends Comparable<V>> for keyOfMax, <K, V extends Number> for sumValues.
keyOfMax should only replace the best candidate when compareTo returns a value strictly greater than 0, so the earliest of equal values is kept.
